description: This file defines the CommandStrategy interface used for handling commands within the persistent actors framework, including methods to match command classes, apply strategies, and check applicability within a context.

classes.name: CommandStrategy
classes.description: Interface for defining command handling strategies with type parameters for command, entity, context, and result.

classes.name: CommandStrategy.Context
classes.description: Nested interface representing the execution context of a command strategy, providing access to state and logging.

methods.name: getMatchingClass
methods.description: Returns the class object for the command type this strategy can handle.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the strategy to a given command within a specific context, entity, and revision, returning a result.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if this strategy is applicable for the provided command.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Default method checking if the strategy can be applied for a command in a specific context and entity.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state from the context.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the diagnostic log adapter from the context.

calls: isDefined(final Context<K> context, @Nullable final S entity, final C command)
